q: Which of the ten task types does 'Give me five pros and five cons of outsourcing payroll versus keeping it in-house' belong to?
explanation: This is a Decide task: it lays out pros and cons so you can weigh a real decision. It is not rewriting, structuring or translating anything.

q: The lesson says to run the ten tasks against your own real work, not invented scenarios. Why does that matter?
options: Real documents are shorter and quicker to paste in
Fluency comes from practising with content you actually use
AI gives better answers to invented scenarios
It makes your results more impressive to share
explanation: Reps build fluency: running the ten tasks on your real email, report and decision makes prompting feel natural by Monday — and the outputs are genuinely useful, not practice fluff.

q: After running the ten tasks, what should you do with your three best results?
options: Delete them to keep your workspace tidy
Mark them with a star — they become the core of your prompt library
Use each one only once so they stay fresh
Compare them to find which tool performed worst
explanation: Mark your three best with a star: they become the core of your prompt library, and later feed your saved templates on Day 11 and your first automations on Day 17.
